requiredFindings.title: The native size-pin inventory omits usize
requiredFindings.finding: The byte formula for discovery_walk.rs::classify_cost includes segments * (2 * size_of::<usize>()) at lines 99-100. The enumerated native size pins omit usize, so the stated list does not cover every compile-time size needed by the byte model. Whole-file source pins do not evaluate target-dependent size_of expressions.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Include usize in the recorded, natively asserted size inventory, or explicitly pin/assert the supported pointer width and derive its byte size from that checked fact. Require every size_of operand in the modeled charge closure to have such a checked source, including the classify_cost term.

requiredFindings.title: Relative scope keys alone do not establish zero root-length cost
requiredFindings.finding: Option (c) promises that relative keys and removal of retained per-name absolute spellings remove R from bytes and reduce per-name object counts. The current walker also charges transient absolute spellings in spell(), root-spelling copies, frame/verdict spellings and scope-entry construction. Those are cumulative ledger charges even when their allocations are promptly dropped. Re-keying retained scope entries alone does not remove all such terms or prove the promised object reduction.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Frame option (c) as a storage redesign whose actual residual base/perRootByte and object costs must be derived, rather than assuming zero R coefficient. If zero R is a design goal, explicitly include elimination/borrowing of the transient and fixed absolute-spelling allocations and verify it in the successor/re-census. Label any pre-successor figures as estimates or a justified counterfactual model; use the bound successor census for final caps.
